```
// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  // Load Chart.js library
  loadChartJS();
  showTab('dashboard');
  refreshDashboard();
  setInterval(refreshDashboard, 20000);  // Refresh co 20 sekund
});

function loadChartJS() {
  // Try to load Chart.js from local storage or use a script tag
  const script = document.createElement('script');
  script.src = '/chart.min.js';
  script.onerror = () => {
    console.warn('Local Chart.js not found, trying CDN...');
    const cdnScript = document.createElement('script');
    cdnScript.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js';
    cdnScript.onerror = () => {
      console.error('Failed to load Chart.js from both local and CDN');
      document.getElementById('chart').style.display = 'none';
    };
    document.head.appendChild(cdnScript);
  };
  document.head.appendChild(script);
}
```

**Input:**

```
# Web UI API Endpoint Fixes

## Issues Identified

### 1. **API Endpoint Mismatches** ❌ → ✅

The HTML web interface was calling endpoints that don't match the firmware implementation:

#### Set Day Functionality
- **Before**: `GET /api/set-day?day=10`
- **After**: `POST /api/tray/set-day` with body `{"tray": 0, "day": 10}`
- **Status**: ✅ Fixed

#### Reset Day Functionality  
- **Before**: `GET /api/reset-day`
- **After**: `POST /api/reset`
- **Status**: ✅ Fixed

#### Reboot Functionality
- **Before**: `GET /api/reboot`
- **After**: `POST /api/reboot`
- **Status**: ✅ Fixed

### 2. **Chart.js CDN Tracking Prevention** 🚫 → 📊

**Error**: `Tracking Prevention blocked access to storage for https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/...`

**Root Cause**: Browser's Tracking Prevention feature blocks cross-site resource loading.

**Solution**:
- Modified HTML to first try loading from local `/chart.min.js`
- Falls back to CDN if local version unavailable
- Gracefully hides chart if both sources fail

**To Enable Chart Locally**:
1. Download Chart.js: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js`
2. Save as `firmware/data/chart.min.js`
3. Rebuild and upload to ESP32 SPIFFS
4. Chart will load from local storage (no CDN needed)

## Files Modified

- **firmware/data/index.html**
  - Line ~7: Removed CDN script tag
  - Line ~641: Changed `resetDay()` to use `POST /api/reset`
  - Line ~649: Changed `setDay()` to use `POST /api/tray/set-day` with JSON body
  - Line ~666: Changed `rebootDevice()` to use `POST /api/reboot`
  - Added `loadChartJS()` function with fallback mechanism

## API Changes Summary

| Function | Old Endpoint | New Endpoint | Method | Change |
|----------|-------------|-------------|--------|--------|
| Set Day | `/api/set-day?day=X` | `/api/tray/set-day` | GET → POST | ✅ Fixed |
| Reset | `/api/reset-day` | `/api/reset` | GET → POST | ✅ Fixed |
| Reboot | `/api/reboot` | `/api/reboot` | GET → POST | ✅ Fixed |
| Chart.js | CDN only | Local + CDN fallback | - | ✅ Fixed |

## Testing

To verify the fixes:

1. **Set Day**: Click "📍 Ustaw Dzień" button and enter a day number (should work now)
2. **Reset Day**: Click "⏱️ Reset Dnia" button (should work now)
3. **Reboot**: Click "🔄 Restart ESP32" button (should work now)
4. **Chart**: Monitor Dashboard tab - chart should display without tracking prevention errors

## Notes

- The `setDay()` function applies to tray 0 by default. To support multiple trays, extend the UI to include tray selection.
- All changes are backward compatible with the firmware API endpoints.
- Chart.js is optional; if unavailable, the chart gracefully hides and other UI elements remain functional.

```

Kompiluj i wyślij firmware. Dla ESP32-S3 procedura: Nie mam PlatformIO zainstalowanego globalnie. Użyj **VS Code + PlatformIO rozszerzenia** zamiast:

## **Procedura USB Upload do ESP32-S3:**

### **1️⃣ Przygotowanie (jeden raz):**
- Otwórz projekt w VS Code (PlatformIO Home)
- Podłącz ESP32-S3 przez USB-C

### **2️⃣ Tryb bootloadera (WAŻNE!):**
- **Przytrzymaj BOOT** (przycisk po lewej stronie portu USB)
- **Wciśnij RESET** (przycisk po prawej) - bez puszczania BOOT
- **Poczekaj 1 sekundę** 
- **Puść oba przyciski**
- → ESP32 wejdzie w tryb bootloader (będzie pulsować LED)

### **3️⃣ Upload w VS Code:**

Na pasku u dołu kliknij: **Upload** (strzałka →)

Lub z Command Palette: `> PlatformIO: Upload`

```
[✓] Kompilacja...
[✓] Czyszczenie...
[✓] Uploading...
[✓] Pobieranie rejestrów...
```

### **4️⃣ Po uploadzie:**
- Wciśnij **RESET** - ESP32 uruchomi się z nowymi poprawkami
- Otwórz Serial Monitor: `> PlatformIO: Monitor`
- Powinny się pojawić logi startowe

## **🎯 Podsumowanie przycisków:**

| Akcja | Procedura |
|-------|-----------|
| **Wjazd do bootloadera** | BOOT (hold) → RESET → Release both |
| **Normalny restart** | RESET |
| **Po uploadzje** | RESET |

    .card.red { border-left-color: #dc3545; }
    .card.blue { border-left-color: #17a2b8; }

    .val-big { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }

      padding: 10px 16px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s;

    .btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: white; }

    .btn-success { background: #28a745; color: white; }
    .btn-secondary { background: #6c757d; color: white; }

    .form-group { margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .form-group label { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #444; margin-bottom: 6px; }

    .toggle-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 12px 0; }
    .toggle { width: 50px; height: 26px; appearance: none; background: #ccc; border-radius: 13px; cursor: pointer; position: relative; }
    .toggle:checked { background: var(--primary); }
    .toggle::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 22px; height: 22px; background: white; border-radius: 50%; top: 2px; left: 2px; transition: 0.3s; }
    .toggle:checked::after { left: 26px; }

    #toast {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 25px;
      right: 25px;

      color: white;
      padding: 15px 22px;

      display: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      min-width: 300px;
    }

  </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>🥚 Inkubator Monitor</h1>
    <p id="hdr-sub">Ładowanie systemu... <span id="conn-indicator" style="margin-left:10px;"></span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="tabs">
    <button class="tab active" onclick="showTab('dashboard')">📊 Dashboard</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('trays')">🗂️ Tace</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('schedule')">📋 Harmonogram</button>
    <button class="tab" onclick="showTab('config')">⚙️ Konfiguracja</button>
  </div>

  <!-- DASHBOARD -->
  <div id="tab-dashboard" class="tab-panel active">
    <div id="alert-bar" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>

    <div class="grid-2">
      <div class="card" id="card-temp">
        <div class="val-label">Temperatura komory</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-temp">--.-°C</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card green">
        <div class="val-label">Wilgotność</div>
        <div class="val-big" id="val-hum">--%</div>
        <div class="val-label" id="val-hum-target">Cel: -- – -- %</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px">
      <h3>🔧 Status systemów</h3>
      <div id="sys-status" style="line-height:1.8;"></div>
    </div>

    <div id="dash-trays" class="grid-3" style="margin-top:16px"></div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-top:20px">
      <h3>📈 Historia pomiarów</h3>
      <canvas id="chart" style="height: 320px;"></canvas>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TACE -->
  <div id="tab-trays" class="tab-panel">
    <div id="trays-container"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- HARMONOGRAM -->
  <div id="tab-schedule" class="tab-panel">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label>Wybierz gatunek</label>
      <select id="sched-species" onchange="loadSchedule()" style="width:100%;padding:12px;">
        <option value="CHICKEN">🐔 Kura (21 dni)</option>
        <option value="DUCK">🦆 Kaczka (28 dni)</option>
        <option value="GOOSE">🦢 Gęś (30 dni)</option>
        <option value="QUAIL">🥚 Przepiórka (17 dni)</option>
        <option value="GUINEA">🐦 Perliczka (26 dni)</option>
        <option value="PHEASANT">🦚 Bażant (24 dni)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">
      <thead><tr><th>Dzień</th><th>Temp (°C)</th><th>Wilg. (%)</th><th>Obrót</th><th>Lockdown</th><th>Uwagi</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="sched-body"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <!-- KONFIGURACJA -->
  <div id="tab-config" class="tab-panel">
    <div id="cfg-alert" class="alert" style="display:none"></div>

    <h3>Tryb pracy</h3>
    <div class="toggle-group">
      <input type="checkbox" class="toggle" id="cfg-test-mode">
      <label for="cfg-test-mode"><strong>Tryb testowy (symulowane dane)</strong></label>
    </div>

    <div class="form-group">
      <label>Temperatura docelowa komory (°C)</label>
      <input type="number" id="cfg-target-temp" step="0.1" value="37.5">
    </div>

    <button class="btn-primary" onclick="saveConfig()" style="width:100%; padding:14px; margin-top:20px;">💾 Zapisz konfigurację</button>
    <button class="btn-danger" onclick="factoryReset()" style="width:100%; margin-top:8px;">⚠️ Przywróć ustawienia fabryczne</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="toast"></div>

<script>
// ==================== GLOBALNE ====================
let currentConfig = null;
let currentChart = null;

// ==================== API ====================
async function api(url, method = 'GET', body = null) {
  try {
    const opts = { method, headers: {} };
    if (body) {
      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    }
    const res = await fetch(url, opts);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    toast("Brak połączenia z inkubatorem!", true);
    throw e;
  }
}

function toast(msg, error = false) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = error ? '#dc3545' : '#28a745';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}

function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[['dashboard','trays','schedule','config'].indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
  if (tab === 'config') loadConfig();
}

// ==================== DASHBOARD ====================
async function refreshDashboard() {
  try {
    const status = await api('/api/status');
    const trays = await api('/api/trays');
    renderDashboard(status, trays);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderDashboard(s, traysData) {
  // Temperatura
  document.getElementById('val-temp').textContent = (s.temp_chamber || 0).toFixed(1) + '°C';
  const tempCard = document.getElementById('card-temp');
  tempCard.className = s.test_mode ? 'card' : (Math.abs(s.temp_chamber - s.target_temp) < 0.6 ? 'card green' : 'card red');

  // Wilgotność
  document.getElementById('val-hum').textContent = Math.round(s.humidity || 0) + '%';
  document.getElementById('val-hum-target').textContent = `Cel: ${s.humidity_target_min || 0}–${s.humidity_target_max || 0}%`;

  // Status
  let html = `
    Grzałka: <strong>${s.heater_pwm || 0}%</strong><br>
    Dyfuzor: <strong>${s.diffuser_on ? '💧 ON' : 'OFF'}</strong><br>
    Drzwi: <strong>${s.door_open ? '⚠️ OTWARTE' : '✓ Zamknięte'}</strong><br>
    Tryb: <strong>${s.test_mode ? '🧪 TESTOWY' : '✓ Normalny'}</strong>
  `;
  document.getElementById('sys-status').innerHTML = html;

  // Alert
  const alertEl = document.getElementById('alert-bar');
  if (s.alert && s.alert.length > 5) {
    alertEl.style.display = 'block';
    alertEl.textContent = s.alert;
    alertEl.className = 'alert alert-danger';
  } else {
    alertEl.style.display = 'none';
  }

  renderDashTrays(traysData);
}

// ==================== TACE ====================
async function loadTrays() {
  try {
    const data = await api('/api/trays');
    renderTrays(data);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderTrays(data) {
  const container = document.getElementById('trays-container');
  container.innerHTML = data.trays.map(t => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <h3>${t.label}</h3>
      <p><strong>${t.species_name}</strong> — Dzień ${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</p>
      <p>Wilgotność: ${t.hum_min}–${t.hum_max}%</p>
      ${t.in_lockdown ? '<strong style="color:#721c24">🛑 LOCKDOWN</strong>' : ''}
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== KONFIGURACJA ====================
async function loadConfig() {
  try {
    currentConfig = await api('/api/config');
    document.getElementById('cfg-test-mode').checked = currentConfig.system?.test_mode || false;
    document.getElementById('cfg-target-temp').value = currentConfig.system?.target_temp || 37.5;
  } catch(e) { toast("Nie można wczytać konfiguracji", true); }
}

async function saveConfig() {
  if (!currentConfig) return;
  currentConfig.system.test_mode = document.getElementById('cfg-test-mode').checked;
  currentConfig.system.target_temp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cfg-target-temp').value);

  try {
    await api('/api/config', 'POST', currentConfig);
    toast("✅ Konfiguracja zapisana! Czujniki zostały zrestartowane.", false);
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1200);
  } catch(e) {
    toast("❌ Błąd zapisu konfiguracji", true);
  }
}

async function factoryReset() {
  if (!confirm("Czy na pewno przywrócić ustawienia fabryczne?")) return;
  try {
    await api('/api/config', 'POST', { factory_reset: true });
    toast("Ustawienia fabryczne przywrócone");
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1500);
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  showTab('dashboard');
  refreshDashboard();
  setInterval(refreshDashboard, 20000);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>  ale chyba jeszce bez wykresu

```
      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    }
    const res = await fetch(url, opts);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    return await res.json();
  } catch (e) {
    toast("Brak połączenia z inkubatorem!", true);
    throw e;
  }
}

function toast(msg, error = false) {
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.background = error ? '#dc3545' : '#28a745';
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => t.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}

function showTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab')[['dashboard','trays','schedule','config'].indexOf(tab)].classList.add('active');

  if (tab === 'trays') loadTrays();
  if (tab === 'schedule') loadSchedule();
  if (tab === 'config') loadConfig();
}

// ==================== DASHBOARD ====================
async function refreshDashboard() {
  try {
    const status = await api('/api/status');
    const trays = await api('/api/trays');
    renderDashboard(status, trays);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderDashboard(s, traysData) {
  // Temperatura
  document.getElementById('val-temp').textContent = (s.temp_chamber || 0).toFixed(1) + '°C';
  const tempCard = document.getElementById('card-temp');
  tempCard.className = s.test_mode ? 'card' : (Math.abs(s.temp_chamber - s.target_temp) < 0.6 ? 'card green' : 'card red');

  // Wilgotność
  document.getElementById('val-hum').textContent = Math.round(s.humidity || 0) + '%';
  document.getElementById('val-hum-target').textContent = `Cel: ${s.humidity_target_min || 0}–${s.humidity_target_max || 0}%`;

  // Status
  let html = `
    Grzałka: <strong>${s.heater_pwm || 0}%</strong><br>
    Dyfuzor: <strong>${s.diffuser_on ? '💧 ON' : 'OFF'}</strong><br>
    Drzwi: <strong>${s.door_open ? '⚠️ OTWARTE' : '✓ Zamknięte'}</strong><br>
    Tryb: <strong>${s.test_mode ? '🧪 TESTOWY' : '✓ Normalny'}</strong>
  `;
  document.getElementById('sys-status').innerHTML = html;

  // Alert
  const alertEl = document.getElementById('alert-bar');
  if (s.alert && s.alert.length > 5) {
    alertEl.style.display = 'block';
    alertEl.textContent = s.alert;
    alertEl.className = 'alert alert-danger';
  } else {
    alertEl.style.display = 'none';
  }

  // Connector indicator
  document.getElementById('conn-indicator').textContent = '✅ Online';

  if (traysData) renderDashTrays(traysData);
}

function renderDashTrays(data) {
  const container = document.getElementById('dash-trays');
  if (!data.trays || data.trays.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p>Brak tac</p>';
    return;
  }
  container.innerHTML = data.trays.map(t => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <div class="val-label">${t.label || `Taca ${t.index}`}</div>
      <div style="font-weight: 700;">${t.species_name || '?'}</div>
      <div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;">Dzień ${t.current_day || 0}/${t.total_days || 0}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== TACE ====================
async function loadTrays() {
  try {
    const data = await api('/api/trays');
    renderTrays(data);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderTrays(data) {
  const container = document.getElementById('trays-container');
  container.innerHTML = data.trays.map(t => `
    <div class="card ${t.in_lockdown ? 'red' : 'green'}">
      <h3>${t.label}</h3>
      <p><strong>${t.species_name}</strong> — Dzień ${t.current_day}/${t.total_days}</p>
      <p>Wilgotność: ${t.hum_min}–${t.hum_max}%</p>
      ${t.in_lockdown ? '<strong style="color:#721c24">🛑 LOCKDOWN</strong>' : ''}
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== HARMONOGRAM ====================
async function loadSchedule() {
  const species = document.getElementById('sched-species').value;
  if (!species) return;
  try {
    const data = await api(`/api/schedule?species=${species}`);
    renderSchedule(data);
  } catch(e) {}
}

function renderSchedule(data) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('sched-body');
  if (!data.schedule) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6">Brak danych</td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  tbody.innerHTML = data.schedule.map(day => `
    <tr>
      <td>${day.day}</td>
      <td>${day.temp_min}–${day.temp_max}</td>
      <td>${day.humidity_min}–${day.humidity_max}</td>
      <td>${day.turn ? '✓' : '✗'}</td>
      <td>${day.lockdown ? '✓' : '✗'}</td>
      <td>${day.notes || ''}</td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');
}

// ==================== KONFIGURACJA ====================
async function loadConfig() {
  try {
    currentConfig = await api('/api/config');
    document.getElementById('cfg-test-mode').checked = currentConfig.system?.test_mode || false;
    document.getElementById('cfg-target-temp').value = currentConfig.system?.target_temp || 37.5;
  } catch(e) { toast("Nie można wczytać konfiguracji", true); }
}

async function saveConfig() {
  if (!currentConfig) return;
  currentConfig.system.test_mode = document.getElementById('cfg-test-mode').checked;
  currentConfig.system.target_temp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cfg-target-temp').value);

  try {
    await api('/api/config', 'POST', currentConfig);

    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1200);
  } catch(e) {
    toast("❌ Błąd zapisu konfiguracji", true);
  }
}

async function factoryReset() {
  if (!confirm("Czy na pewno przywrócić ustawienia fabryczne?")) return;
  try {
    await api('/api/config', 'POST', { factory_reset: true });
    toast("Ustawienia fabryczne przywrócone");
    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 1500);
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ==================== INICJALIZACJA ====================
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  showTab('dashboard');
  refreshDashboard();
  setInterval(refreshDashboard, 20000);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
